body:
Fable2 #6039 (2026-11-14 ~01:45Z) ruling on the P0 scroll fix w-84132b835175 (Opus3; no review pair, by Greg's "nie uruchamiaj code reviews"):
- The landing rests on Greg's own word in the ACTING session.
- His check-in word is in Opus3's session, so OPUS3 does the fast-forward of master and the push, from the master checkout. Opus2 does NOT.
- Opus2: runs the FULL on the byte-identical re-cut after combo99c lands; does the integration checks (origin/master == base, fast-forward, the 17 ui/src paths byte-identical to what Greg tested); then sends Opus3 an explicit GO with the gated commit id.
- Opus3 re-verifies those three facts, restores main's staged paths right before the fast-forward, pushes, and verifies the remote contains the commit.
- If the FULL fails or any path must change, Greg re-tests before any landing.
- No separate install: Greg restarts with git pull + cargo run --release.
- No tracker ids in the commit body.
- After the landing and Greg's confirmation, Fable2 proposes RESET NOW to Engram::Fable.
Remove once the scroll fix has landed.
